in_sanskrit.name: Sonalal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Son of Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sonalal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sonalal is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chandra’, which means ‘Moon’. Sonalal is a beautiful name for a baby girl, signifying the beauty of the moon. The name Sonalal signifies calmness and gentleness, making it a perfect name for a girl who is gentle and peaceful.
